subject: Living-room storage around real routines
hook: Alcove units designed around how you live
gbp:
Bespoke living-room storage, planned around how your household actually uses the room.

Whether it is a pair of alcoves either side of a chimney breast in Stone, a full media wall, or a sideboard sized for one particular wall, we design living-room furniture around your routines: where the keys land, where the toys go at bedtime, and where the remotes and cables disappear to.

What is included:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation
- A full measure, noting sockets, radiators and skirting, followed by an itemised quote with no hidden costs
- Manufacture and assembly in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked before delivery
- Installation by our own team, scribed to your walls

Choose from matt, super matt, gloss, painted, slatted and wood-effect finishes, with soft-close as standard.

Book your free consultation to plan your living room.
